annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC 25059:2023 Software engineering — Systems and software Quality Requirements and Evaluation (SQuaRE) — Quality model for AI systems
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC 25059:2023 Software engineering — Systems and software Quality Requirements and Evaluation (SQuaRE) — Quality model for AI systems
annotation.summary_en: ISO store catalogue page for ISO/IEC 25059:2023, a quality model for AI systems extending the SQuaRE series. It gives consistent terminology and characteristics for specifying, measuring and evaluating AI system quality. Status is under revision (stage 90.92), expected to be replaced by ISO/IEC FDIS 25059.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines a quality model for AI systems as an application-specific extension of SQuaRE
Provides characteristics and sub-characteristics for specifying, measuring and evaluating AI quality
Allows stated quality requirements to be checked for completeness
Stage 90.92: to be revised; to be replaced by ISO/IEC FDIS 25059
